descripcion: A sarcastic floating art-toy head over a moving wall of COOL CULTURE CLUB type, cut hard against the artist's paintings (drifting, magnified, revealed), a modern bricolage portrait and a torn-strip quote card. Fast, warm, coral-to-teal.

tokens.fondo: gradient ramp #FC604C at y 291 to #132019 at y 1362

ritmo.avatar_en_pantalla: about 45% of the time, 5 blocks (L01, L03, L05, L08, L10)

salto_avatar.que: every avatar cut lands slightly big and settles

punch_in.que: a beat inside an avatar line punches in close

deriva_obra.claves: scale +3% to +10% over 2-3 s, or a 70 -> 78% drift on wide panels

empuje_detalle.que: push to a detail on the anchor

revelado.que: zoom out from a detail to the whole panel
revelado.claves: scale 200% -> 61% over 6.2 s with the anchor travelling

jitter.que: stop-motion hold once a bricolage piece lands
jitter.amplitud: 0.3 deg subject, 0.4-0.6 paper and tape, 1-2 stickers and marks; a strip and its text share the seed

transiciones: Hard cuts between shots, on the end of a phrase; layers overlap 0.1-0.3 s so nothing flashes.
No wipes or dissolves between shots: the energy comes from the avatar's settle and the artwork's motion.
Inside modules pieces enter with Scale Pop, Slide Land, Wipe Reveal (angle 270 for left to right, 0 for drips), Rotate Settle, Drop Bounce, Spin Pop, Stretch Slide, Words Fade Up.

modulos.avatar_plate: Seedance clip with an Object Matte roto of the head; behind it the kinetic type wall (graded to black on coral) and the coral-to-teal gradient. 1-3 punch-ins per line.
modulos.kinetic_type_wall: Rows of COOL CULTURE CLUB in Bahnschrift 240 px, row pitch 194, slant -14, narrow width 78% / tracking -19; the weight sweeps light -> bold condensed and back (cycle 6 s, sweep 2.8 s, row stagger 0.3 s, ease power 2.5). kit/loops/kinetic_type_wall.mp4
modulos.bricolage_portrait: 6 s: background pieces 0.10-0.55 s (paper circle, riso, halftone, torn papers, black square, tapes, spiral); cutout Drop Bounce at 0.70 s (impact 1.03, settle 1.57); halo, tabs, clip, price tag, pin 1.05-1.40; pink tape, drip, NAME LABEL 1.45-1.60; stickers, sparkle, number, X 1.75-2.15; then stop-motion jitter. Caption: name, place, year.
modulos.artwork: full painting or panel, Ken Burns drift; title cards optional (SuisseIntlMono 40, white).
modulos.detail_zoom: the painting behind (push-in 4%), then 1-2 cards magnifying a detail (card 780x1040 rot -1.5 at x2.2; card 600x760 rot 2 at x6.5) with tape on top and a 45% shadow, entering on their word.
modulos.quote_card: each line on its own torn cream strip (text width +120, height +70) wiping left to right at 0.60/0.95/1.30/1.65 s, words fade up 0.15 s after; Instrument Serif Italic 112, warm black; attribution in Bahnschrift on black tape at 2.15 s; big cream quote mark.
modulos.cta_button: cream/amber pill 'Comment below' under the captions on the last line (Motion DNA element button).
modulos.captions: Poppins SemiBold 66, cream #F6E8D7, the word being spoken in amber #E3C971 (expression selector per word), 2-4 words per group, no box, soft drop shadow, at y ~1460.
modulos.alternativos: Art Carousel, Art Slider, Art Strip, Art Scroll, Ken Burns Details, Kinetic Type: built in the template, not used in the Bosch cut; options for listing several works.

musica.tags: playful upbeat indie hip-hop beat, bright plucks, light drums, 95-110 BPM, no vocals
musica.nota: guide only: the real song goes in the app

builder_nota: ae/ccc.jsx (engine/build_collage.py, branch ccc). The Bosch AE template in references/bosch_template stays as the hand-built reference.

tipografia.subtitulos: Poppins-SemiBold 66 (stand-in on machines without Poppins: InterTight-SemiBold)

cabeza.medido: Seedance clips of the Bosch cut, matte (InSPyReNet) + head box per frame (references/head/*.json)
cabeza.alto_cabeza: cap top to chin = 57-66% of the frame height; cap top at 11-14% from the top, chin at 71-77%; the hair falls to the bottom edge
cabeza.ancho: ears reach 94-100% of the width in the close clip, ~70% in the wider one
cabeza.movimiento: locked horizontally (centre moves 2-12 px), bobs and leans vertically 25-67 px; no camera move inside the clip
cabeza.en_edicion: cut-in 109% -> 102% in 4 frames; punch-in 144% -> 134% at sentence ends, anchored at the eyes (the cap and ears crop on the punch)
cabeza.h3: H3 renders the head smaller (about half the width): the edit's cover scale + punch-ins bring it back to the reference size
